info.title: Enterprise PMS API
info.description: Centralized online-first PMS. All project paths require explicit project membership. Web refresh cookies require a trusted Origin. Native routes return refresh tokens only for OS secure storage. Financial values are decimal strings. Critical workflows use immutable records, approval checks and serializable transactions.
